description: Trafic de voyageurs et marchandises depuis 1841 is a dataset listed in SNCF Open Data, an open data portal of a railway operator, published or maintained by SNCF. Évolution des trafics de voyageurs et marchandises depuis 1841, pour le transport ferroviaire en France (comprenant EPIC SNCF-iDTGV, Eurostar, Thalys sur la période récente). Attention, la Direction Fret a changé ses méthodes de calcul concernant les données de trafic marchandises: à partir de 2008, le périmètre inclut les filiales. Coverage: France. The portal flags it as a time series. The portal files it under Informations institutionnelles et financières. Its keywords are trafic, trafic voyageurs, trafic marchandises, voyageurs. The portal shows 2017-04-12 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open Database License (ODbL) (https://data.sncf.com/pages/licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-sncf-open-data-portal.
